scientific_question: Can QuTE learn quantum transformation semantics that remain correct across syntactically different but physically equivalent circuit representations?
primary_failure_addressed: semantic and Composition-OOD model error, not hardware noise

base_depths.definition: canonical base-circuit depth before rewrite; expanded depth is also reported

scope.full_unitary_policy: oracle-only four-qubit diagnostic; not a required candidate output or scale path
candidate_contract: state/probe action or requested measurement statistics

templates: swap adjacent gates with disjoint qubit supports
swap adjacent reviewed RZ gates on distinct qubits
insert or remove H(q) X(q) X(q) H(q)
insert or remove CNOT(c,t) H(q) H(q) CNOT(c,t) when H support is disjoint from both CNOT qubits
CNOT(c,t) <-> H(c) H(t) CNOT(t,c) H(c) H(t)
CNOT(a,b) CNOT(b,a) CNOT(a,b) <-> CNOT(b,a) CNOT(a,b) CNOT(b,a)
nonlocal_operator_semantics.semantic_relation: same SWAP operator on qubits a and b

non_equivalent_controls.required_ratio: one matched negative per positive pair
non_equivalent_controls.purpose: prevent a trivial syntax-invariant or constant-output model from appearing semantically correct
construction: single parameter perturbation with oracle operator distance at least 0.1
match base depth and token count where possible

oracle.primary: exact four-qubit unitary equivalence up to global phase
independent_checks: action agreement on all 16 computational-basis probes
Z-basis measurement-distribution agreement on 16 computational-basis probes

split_axes.semantic_iid: unseen base circuits and rewrite instances from the three seen rewrite families
split_axes.rewrite_instance_ood: held-out templates or parameterizations within the three seen families
split_axes.rewrite_family_ood: identity-insertion/removal family absent from training and development
split_axes.cross_decomposition_ood: reverse-direction CNOT decomposition absent from training and development
split_axes.parameter_ood: frozen interpolation and extrapolation regions crossed with seen semantic families
split_axes.depth_ood: canonical base depths 8 and 10 crossed with seen semantic families
split_axes.state_probe_ood: held-out entangled and Haar probes used to query frozen transformations
split_axes.non_equivalent_control: one matched negative evaluated alongside every positive pair

corpus_allocation.unit: positive equivalent pair; every positive has one matched negative

probe_policy.train_and_development: product states from the frozen generator family
probe_policy.probe_seed_derivation: SHA-256(protocol_hash || partition || circuit_id || probe_index), reduced to uint64

leakage_rules: base-circuit identity disjoint across train, development, and final test
canonical operator hash must not cross partitions except within an explicitly linked equivalent pair
rewrite instance identity disjoint across partitions
held-out rewrite and decomposition families absent from training and development
probe/state IDs disjoint where state/probe OOD is claimed
non-equivalent controls cannot share their perturbed target operator with a positive pair
opened final-test examples never become development data

primary: mean semantic action fidelity against the ideal oracle
metrics.selection_score: harmonic mean of the three development primary metrics, macro-averaged first by family then split
systems: teacher calls avoided on repeated equivalent workloads

thresholds.interpretation: absolute benchmark support floors; candidate comparisons are also reported without converting nonsignificant deltas into wins

statistics.method: paired stratified bootstrap over base-circuit identities

candidate_policy.tie_policy: within 0.001 select lower measured latency; if still tied select fewer trainable parameters; if still tied retain both without test-based selection
candidate_policy.verdict_rule: SUPPORTED only if all absolute floors pass and candidate-minus-baseline development-selected deltas are positive for every seed; QUALIFIED if floors pass and mean deltas are positive with mixed seed signs; otherwise NOT_SUPPORTED

allowed_if_supported: a candidate generalizes across the frozen reviewed semantic families and splits
a representation improves semantic consistency relative to predeclared baselines
OOD/fallback detects a measured fraction of semantic failures
prohibited: hardware-noise learning from this simulator-teacher benchmark
causal architecture claims from descriptive comparisons

out_of_scope: model training or candidate selection during protocol freeze
changes to QuTE North Star v1.0
post-hoc changes driven by final-test outcomes

freeze_gate.reason_execution_not_authorized: protocol-only task; generation requires a separate explicit run
